tool_input.message:
Mission m-2026-10-18-008 round 1 complete. All five confirmed defects fixed, make check clean before each commit, pushed to origin design/opencode-plugin-adapter (updates PR #536), mission result submitted (verdict=pass, confidence=0.9). Did not advance/close the mission or touch the PR itself, per instructions.

Commits (in order):
- 9c7e3ef docs: fix 5 confirmed review defects in OpenCode plugin design (ethos-5y4r)
- 02ce623 docs: sync DES-078 ADR with round-2 design fixes (ethos-5y4r)
- 8119998 chore(missions): record m-2026-10-18-008 round-1 result (ethos-5y4r)

Files changed: <repo>/docs/design-opencode-plugin.md, <repo>/DESIGN.md

What I fixed, per finding:

1. **Finding 1** (session roster missing before claim): §2.1 now requires `ethos session create --session <id> --root-id <id> --primary-id <id>` (existing, `Hidden: true` primitive, `cmd/ethos/session.go:79/684-692`) before any `ethos mission claim`, since `RefuseIfSessionGone` (`internal/hook/pretooluse_dispatch.go:494`) calls `ss.Load(sessionID)` and fails closed on a session with no roster file. Added new §2.1.1 covering plugin-restart reconciliation: enumerate live sessions via `ctx.session.list(...)` (`.tmp/effect.mdx:833-837`) and re-run `session create` idempotently (`writeRoster` always overwrites via temp+rename, no `O_EXCL`), which never touches the active-mission/delegation-binding sidecars so an existing claim survives.

2. **Finding 2** (wrong hook cited for env propagation): verified directly — `.tmp/effect.mdx:1484-1500` and `.tmp/plugins-index.mdx:1740-1754`'s `ToolHooks`/`ToolExecuteBefore` have no `env` field; `.tmp/effect.mdx:1436-1451`/`.tmp/plugins-index.mdx:1708-1719`'s `ShellHooks`/`ShellCreateBefore` do (`env: Record<string, string | undefined>`). Corrected §1.2, §1.3, §3.2, §3.3, §7.2, and DESIGN.md's DES-078 Decision/non-goals sections from `ctx.tool.hook("execute.before", ...)` to `ctx.shell.hook("create.before", ...)` for `ETHOS_SESSION` propagation. Important: I could **not** confirm that `ShellCreateBefore` carries any `sessionID`-correlating field (it doesn't, per the same interface read) or that OpenCode pairs a `create.before` shell spawn deterministically with the `execute.before` tool call that issued it under concurrent-session load. Rather than assume a "most recently seen session" proxy is safe, I disclosed this explicitly as a new open item in §3.2/§3.3 with a stated fail-closed default (don't set `ETHOS_SESSION` when correlation is ambiguous — degrades to the existing silent no-trailer case rather than risking a wrong one).

3. **Finding 3** (no server-side witness verification): added §2.3.2 — a new `Roster.ParentSession string` field on `internal/session/session.go`'s `Roster` struct, populated by a new `--parent-session <id>` flag on `ethos session create`, written at `ForkSession` time from the wire-confirmed `parentID` (`.tmp/session-event.ts:187-201`). `claim-forked`'s ancestor-set guard now walks this Go-stored chain (`ss.Load(sessionID).ParentSession`) instead of trusting the plugin's `--witness` CLI argument outright.

4. **Finding 5** (missing DelegationBinding write): §5 point 2 now specifies `claim-forked` must also call `mission.WriteDelegationBinding` inside the same `mission.WithDispatchPendingLock` critical section as the claim write, mirroring `internal/hook/pretooluse_dispatch.go:881-888`'s existing three-write dispatch pattern — otherwise `WriteCommitTrailers`'s same-mission check (`commit_trailers.go:65`) finds no binding and the `Delegation:` trailer silently never appears.

5. **Finding 4** (procedural — make docs vs make check): ran full `make check` before each of the two substantive commits this round; logs at `<repo>/.tmp/check-r2-1.log` and `.tmp/check-r2-3.log` (an intermediate `.tmp/check-r2-2.log` caught one markdownlint MD018 false-positive — a line starting with `#536` parsed as an atx heading — fixed with a non-breaking space).

6. **Finding 6** (unverified cross-repo claim): verified directly rather than guessing. Read `~/Coding/punt-labs/points/.bin/check-dev-config.sh:16-18` (confirmed: fails the build if `opencode.json` has any `"plugins"` key at all) and `points/Makefile:29-30,104-105` (confirmed: `make doctor` depends on `make check-dev`, which runs that script). This is a real, confirmed conflict — documented in a new §6.1 in the design doc and mirrored into DESIGN.md's non-goals bullets, explicitly flagged as an open operator decision, not resolved and not ignored.

7. **Finding 7**: untouched, per instructions — leader is handling the PR reply directly.

Scope discipline: did not touch §1 (except the hook-count/propagation fix), §2.1-2.2 bodies (except the new §2.1.1/§2.3.2 additions), §2.3-2.3.1, §3.1, §4, or any of §7's seven rejected alternatives — all read in full and left as-is, per the leader's prior verification.

Open items I'm surfacing for your review (not resolved by me, named explicitly in the doc):
- The `ctx.shell.hook`/`ctx.tool.hook` sessionID-correlation gap under concurrent OpenCode sessions (§3.2/§3.3) — needs a live `opencode serve` to confirm.
- The `punt-labs/points` `make doctor` conflict with `ethos enable --opencode` (§6.1) — needs an operator ruling on how to reconcile, if at all.

Mission result YAML: `<repo>/.tmp/mission-008-result.yaml` (submitted via `ethos mission result`, now also committed under `.punt-labs/ethos/missions/m-2026-10-18-008/`).
